d:
I have notice a terrible lack of this dude and his artworks (or really any of his other comics to be real). So I went and saved up all the work he had ever posted on his places. Some of them are stuff he did more of the coloring to but I still went and included them for this.

Unfortunately, some of the more juicy works he does can only be found on his Patreon. This includes some arts/art sets and half his comic works. So if you want to see them you will need to go pay a visit to his Patreon to see the more exclusive.

In any case. Hope you like what you are seeing here! ^^
